''See also: [[Sha Leiala Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sha Leiala, also known as the [[Luminous Queen]], was a ruler of the [[Ninecloud]] people for two centuries. A member of the Sha bloodline, she possessed a spiritual mutation known as [[royal madra]], which allows for the control of other spirits. Her reign ended prematurely after she sustained damage to her lifeline while fighting a group of powerful plague-spirits following a disaster in her territory. To prevent instability and potential coups within the [[Ninecloud Court]], her death was kept secret from the general public. Instead, the [[Sha family]] maintains an illusion of her continued presence through regular appearances across the nation, leading citizens to believe she remains healthy and powerful. Her inheritance and [[Monarch]]-level abilities were passed down to her daughter, [[Sha Miara]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sha Leiala manifests as a presence composed of multicolored light. She has not made an open appearance for several years.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|She is a [[Monarch]] who ruled over the [[Ninecloud]] people for two centuries. She held a hatred for [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|She is the mother of [[Sha Miara]], who is her direct descendant. She also maintained a hatred for [[Reigan Shen]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|She utilizes the [[Path of Celestial Radiance]]. As the [[Luminous Queen]], she possesses the power to restrain guests within the [[Ninecloud Court]].}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|As the [[Luminous Queen]], Sha Leiala ruled over the [[Ninecloud]] people for two hundred years. She is a [[Monarch]] associated with the [[Ninecloud Court]], where her power is used to restrain guests. Additionally, she is the mother of [[Sha Miara]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sha Leiala is the [[Luminous Queen]] of the [[Ninecloud Court]], manifesting as a presence composed of multicolored light.
